Widget Accounts

(Updated as on January 10, 2026)

Q 1. What is a Widget Account?

Q 2. Who can open a Widget Account?

Q.3. Can interest be paid on it ?

Q 1. What is a Widget Account?

Ans. A Widget Account is an account maintained in widgets with an authorised bank.

Q 2. Who can open a Widget Account?

Ans. Banks shall open it only for resident individuals.

i) The bank must verify the customer before opening the account;

ii) The account may be joint.

Q. 3. Can interest be paid on it?

Ans. No.
